hold_text: The APK ships to the live prop phone (breakout_2). Change is read-only page-side: Positions/Closed-orders read now waits for the tab chips on the /trade terminal, can open the account's terminal href first, and a miss posts a masked diagnostic. No order path, no config, reconcile still report_only.
why: Prop tracking is broken: positions_state=no_tab on every read since the #17793 deploy, so a filled ticket still reads as a working order (operator 2026-10-12: 'we need to be able to track the prop trades').
